title: From finance to luxury baking, RHOL's Nessie Welschinger's career and net worth
excerpt: She had the honour of making the Queen's 90th birthday cake
content:
Nessie Welschinger is a super luxury baker, which has made her millions before appearing on The Real Housewives of London. She’s also an investment banker, so while Karen Loderick-Peace and Amanda Cronin argue over how many properties they own, Nessie is also rich.

She is the founder and CEO of Chelsea Cake Company and also runs Cooking With Kids & Co, which launched its own cookbook. Her high-end custom cakes have reportedly sold for up to £15,000, with supplies to venues such as The Ritz and Claridge’s. Fancy!

Nessie owns a home in Chelsea, London, and a property in the Cotswolds, with an estimated net worth of £3.7 million. Her husband, Remy Welschinger  is the CEO of Arc Minerals Limited and founder of Limehouse Capital, and has a net worth of around £7 million.

Her business, Chelsea Cake Company, has £25k in assets as of 2025 filings on Companies House. It really is just Nessie working for the brand, as they only have one employee listed on the official documents, and there’s a 4.8-star rating on the Google Reviews!

 Nessie worked as global head of equity at Schroders, and worked in financial markets for over a decade, such as at Absolute Capital Management and Handelsbanken, but left corporate finance to pursue a more creative path after feeling limited by finance roles.

She then founded her cake company around 2012 after early baking requests from friends, and nowadays, the bespoke cake business operates from a kitchen outside London and delivers to London and parts of southwest England. Oh, and she was on Bake Off?!

 Nessie competed on Bake Off: The Professionals in 2021, representing her company alongside her friend, Domino. Sadly, she was eliminated in the second week, but started strong, landing joint first place on the leaderboard after a chocolate fruit crumble showpiece.

When she’s not busy sharing her lifestyle on RHOL, Nessie runs Cooking with Kids, a social platform aimed at encouraging healthy eating and cooking with children across England. Her cookbook features 20 recipes, making veg, proteins, and healthy fats exciting.
